title: Closest Published Method for Each A3E-DNS Component, With the Configuration Used Here and Where It Is Specified and Evaluated

rows.closest_published_method: Module-LWE key encapsulation with SE(3) re-randomization [48,49,70]
rows.what_thesis_adds: Traffic-keyed schedule on SE(3)^n with hardware entropy; rotational component to key material, translational to IV and rotation cadence; diffusion coefficient bounded away from zero

rows.closest_published_method: Ring-LWE encryption with NTT and AVX-512 batching [48,49,198,199]
rows.what_thesis_adds: Parameter set n=256, q=4096; selective operation set restricted to the statistical tests the detector needs; pipeline parallelization depth 3 on 16 cores

rows.closest_published_method: Transformer with DP-SGD and geometric-median aggregation [128,181,182]
rows.what_thesis_adds: Spatio-temporal attention with temporal-decay encoding; min-max adversarial training with PGD; cross-checked aggregation against the topological detector
Operational integration into the A3E-DNS pipeline
Three-stage protocol-specific metadata-extraction pipeline for DoH/DoT/DoQ
Encrypted-DNS-specific partitioning, feature engineering and label integration

rows.closest_published_method: MDP and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman optimal control with protocol-specific isolation [99,187]
rows.what_thesis_adds: DoH stream termination, DoT TLS reset, DoQ connection migration; trigger by KL/Rényi divergence

notes: No row in this table claims a new algorithm or a new cryptographic primitive. The 'what this thesis adds' column records the parameterization, integration and evaluation conditions under which the cited published method was used; the last column points to where each configuration is specified and where its contribution is measured.
